cohorts.title: Default NextEval / perturbed
cohorts.caveat: Full 92-problem research set; 27/276 native runs have provider, time-limit or invalid-start anomalies. Default model: DeepSeek V4 Flash. Scores are rounded archive values, not a new Harbor ranking.

cohorts.title: Default NextEval / noisy
cohorts.caveat: Full 92-problem research set; 61/276 native runs have provider, time-limit or invalid-start anomalies. Default model: DeepSeek V4 Flash. Scores are rounded archive values, not a new Harbor ranking.

cohorts.title: GPT + NextEval / noisy
cohorts.caveat: Windows/WSL2 archive. Same Codex harness, medium effort; GPT-5.5 has substantial early stopping. This is not a cross-platform or causal intelligence ranking.

cohorts.title: DeepSeek + NextEval / noisy
cohorts.caveat: Claude Code, thinking off. Both provider routes appear in the archive; Flash scores above Pro in this fixed two-model view. Model tiers alone do not establish an optimization advantage.

cohorts.title: Qwen + NextEval / noisy
cohorts.caveat: Codex, 92 problems, five repeats. This two-model view puts off slightly ahead; the five-solver reference set reverses the order. Tool-feedback and termination issues remain confounds.

cohorts.title: DeepSeek Flash + NextEval / rotated
cohorts.caveat: MISRA1ALS was excluded before the run. 91 problems, not the current 92-problem Bench. No cross-cohort start or seed equivalence is claimed.

policy: Each archive uses its complete recorded participant set and its own COBYQA where available; Qwen has no COBYQA anchor. No cross-cohort pooling, ranking, best-repeat selection, timeout retry, or price inference.
